seo.title: Judy — Snooty bear cub
seo.description: Judy the snooty cub in ACNH—sparkling eyes, elegant room style, and a gentle luxury mood for dress-up islands.

acnh.appearance: Judy is a bear cub washed in ice-blue fur that fades to pastel pink across her body, with a white face, rosy cheeks, small black nose, and V-shaped mouth. White paw pads dot her feet; a round white tail and cream inner ears soften the palette. Cyan shadow and thick black lashes frame dark purple starry eyes — when shocked they flash white with a tiny purple iris and wrinkle lines; when closed, sparkles still glimmer on her lashes like quiet constellations.
acnh.personality: Judy's snooty chic arrives with polish that can sound belittling — fashion critiques, dress sense barbs, an uptown tone that stings before friendship forms. Cranky, big sister, smug, and fellow snooty villagers match her wavelength; jocks question her fitness and normal villagers' relentless kindness can grate on her sharper edges. Beneath the edge is someone who cares about aesthetics and respect in equal measure, softening slowly for neighbors who meet her standards.
